style_name: Vintage broadsheet Swiss grid conference poster
style_summary: A highly dense 9:16 vertical poster acting as a vintage newspaper front page. It utilizes a strict multi-column Swiss grid to organize massive amounts of data. The top 20% features a constrained surrealist collage header and massive title. The bottom 80% is a rigorous 2-column typographic grid filled with micro-typography. The aesthetic relies on distressed hot-metal typesetting, visible ink bleed, and structured dividing lines to keep the heavy data legible and visually striking.

environment_variables.HEADER_TITLE: The main event title (e.g., '2026 AI TECH SUMMIT').
environment_variables.HEADER_VISUAL: A wide, horizontally constrained surrealist collage metaphor to set the tone.
environment_variables.ALL_CONFERENCE_DATA: The massive text payload containing all 7 themes and their bullet points, to be distributed across columns.

composition.global_margins: Mandatory 8% empty padding on all four edges.

spatial_anchors.header_zone: Top 0% to 25%. Contains the HEADER_TITLE and HEADER_VISUAL. Separated from the text by a heavy horizontal line.
spatial_anchors.data_grid_zone: Top 25% to 100%. Divided strictly into TWO vertical columns (Left Column and Right Column), separated by a 0.5pt vertical dividing line in the exact center.

composition.depth_logic: Literal flat analog newspaper printing. Everything is pressed into the paper.

typography.letterform_character: Authentic 1960s vintage newspaper print, old mechanical hot-metal typesetting Chinese font, heavy ink bleed

hierarchy.alignment: Flush-left or perfectly justified across the top

hierarchy.style: Medium size, heavy weight Chinese Heiti, acting as subheadings inside the columns
hierarchy.treatment: Highlighted with a subtle background block in vintage orange or simply heavily inked

hierarchy.style: Small scale (micro-typography), regular weight Chinese Mingti
hierarchy.treatment: Strict flush-left, ragged-right, tightly kerned but with clear leading (line spacing)
hierarchy.alignment: Constrained strictly within the left or right column bounds

text_constraints: CRITICAL: Text MUST wrap within its designated column and never cross the center dividing line
Maintain a clear visual hierarchy between Theme Titles and Bullet Points

grid_dividers.placement: One primary VERTICAL line slicing the bottom 75% in half. Multiple HORIZONTAL lines separating themes.

header_collage.placement: Confined to the top header zone, sitting behind or next to the main title
